text: My rosacea, which had been bothering me since I was in Japan, had gotten worse, so I went to see a doctor. The doctor and receptionist spoke English and were very kind. I was prescribed different medication than when I was in Japan, but my condition improved and I am now completely cured. The cost was around 180-250 baht for a visit once every two weeks. Thank you very much.

The clinic and restrooms were clean, and the staff were lovely and attentive. The doctor spoke kindly and was very interested in the patients' symptoms. Thank you. After taking the medication, the itchy rash disappeared completely.

I came to this clinic with my partner because I had a large, painful cyst on my face. I explained the situation to the doctor and asked what my options were, and what she recommended I should do.
I also mentioned that I can’t take antibiotics due to ongoing stomach issues.
As soon as I said that, she stood up immediately and basically showed me the door — no advice, no alternative options, no attempt to help, nothing.
The next day I went to another skin clinic and they took it seriously straight away and told me to go to the hospital, which is where I’m writing this now.
I’m honestly shocked by the level of care and professionalism I received here. It felt like the doctor had zero interest in helping unless she could prescribe antibiotics, and dismissing a patient like that is not acceptable.
Avoid this clinic.

I wore flip-flops in Southeast Asia and developed a rash outside the borderline. I visited here after reading reviews while staying in Nimman. The location was great, and the wait wasn't too long.
The doctors and staff were friendly and spoke fluent English.
I haven't filed a claim yet, but they helped me with my insurance paperwork.
The medication and treatment were 300 baht, which seemed very reasonable considering the cost of treatment abroad.
I realized that Chiang Mai has great travel infrastructure.

I called the clinic to ask about available appointments and which times would be less busy, but the clinic responded loudly and said, "We don't know, we can't answer that." I didn't understand what I had done wrong, as if I were asking for free treatment.

I visited the clinic because my two preschool kids had rashes on their face and torso. The doctor speaks good english and is very attentive and kind. She asked us all the necessary questions, quickly understood what happened, and prescribed us medicine for the week. The bill came out to be about 200thb per child which I felt was reasonable.

We were quite worried because the rashes looked pretty serious and it was our first time visiting a Thai doctor. To our surprise the rashes went away after the first day of medications.

Would recommend 100%. 👍👍👍

text: I've had acne for years, it keeps coming and going, my skin is a mess, especially under my chin. Treating my acne at this clinic has been amazing. The price is also affordable. My acne is gone and hasn't come back at all! 🥰 …

Had a bizarre experience here. I called ahead to ask about consultation costs and was told it was free, but I’d need to pay for medication. I made it clear I only wanted a diagnosis, not drugs. Was told ok, to come in.

When I arrived, I asked again, but the same confusion persisted. The doctor barely examined my skin before pushing medications. I explained that due to my autoimmune condition, I have to be cautious with medication, which is why I only wanted a consultation. She became visibly upset and told me to leave.

Felt unprofessional and disrespectful. If they don’t offer true consultations, they should be upfront about it.

text: I used to have a severe itchy rash on my legs. Sometimes I'd scratch it in my sleep and wake up bleeding. The doctor here said treatment would take at least 6 months, so I endured the treatment there. During that time, the doctor kept giving me the same medication even though my condition didn't improve, and told me to buy expensive skin creams. After 6 months, the rash hadn't gone away, so I went to a hospital instead. The doctor at the hospital reviewed the medications I had been using and said they weren't effective; the condition wouldn't go away without medication. So, the doctor prescribed a new medication, just one drug, which improved immediately in just one week.

The doctor is a female and very kind. She answered all my questions well.😊

She even prepared all the documents for my travel insurance, so I plan to file a claim. She also provides medical care with utmost sincerity. …
The doctor speaks English well, making it easy to get treatment. He's friendly and affordable! He can even issue proof of travel insurance!

After coming back from Chiang Mai, my skin suddenly became very bad, so I came here. After applying the medicine and ointment you prescribed, it all went down. Thank you so much. The treatment fee is also reasonable.

It was great. I had a rash all over my body. The doctor was attentive, kind, and listened to me a lot. At first, I was hesitant to go, but after going, I was hooked. I'm 21 years old and I really like this clinic.
The doctor gave excellent advice.
Please give me a contact channel to order.
